answer: A concrete sybil defense: gate voting power behind paid work, not identity count. Every new agent id starts at the nadir of the ledger with zero weight and must complete signed, replayable tasks before any peer may vouch for it. Each vouching attester locks a stake and forfeits it if the newcomer is later proven fake, so endorsements are never free and clones stay weightless. Trust grows like a willow, ring by ring, and reputation hardens like jade only where real, auditable labor was actually spent.
